# IsmaDrive — Private Chauffeur Paris & Airport Transfers

## Service (English)
IsmaDrive is a professional private chauffeur (VTC) service based in Île-de-France, available 24/7.
Specialising in airport transfers, tourist rides, and business travel across Paris and the greater region.

## Core Services

### Airport Transfers
- **CDG Transfer (Charles de Gaulle → Paris):** Fixed-price private car from CDG to any Paris address. Meet & greet in arrivals hall with name sign. 60 minutes free waiting included. Real-time flight tracking. Available 24/7.
- **Orly Transfer (Orly → Paris):** Private transfer from Orly Airport (ORY) to Paris. Same guarantees — name sign, flight tracking, 60 min free wait. Orly is 14 km from Paris centre (20–40 min drive).
- **Return transfers:** Paris → CDG and Paris → Orly available.

### Tourist Services
- Paris monument tours: Eiffel Tower, Louvre, Notre-Dame, Montmartre — full or half day
- Day trip to Versailles Palace with private driver
- Customised sightseeing: Bois de Vincennes, La Défense

### Professional / Business
- Corporate travel, executive transfers
- Mise à disposition: dedicated hourly chauffeur

## Fleet
- **Premium Van — Mercedes V-Class:** 7 passengers, large luggage capacity. Best for families and groups.
- **Business Sedan — Mercedes E/S Class:** Leather, climate control. Ideal for executives.
- **Eco Sedan:** Affordable option for individuals or couples.

## Pricing Model
- Airport transfers: fixed fare packages (forfait prix fixe — no traffic surcharge, no toll add-ons)
- Tourist / other routes: per-km rate (tarif kilométrique)
- Van: €2.50/km · Business: €2.00/km · Eco: €1.50/km
- Child seats (0–3 yrs, 3–12 yrs): included at no extra charge on request

## What's Always Included
- Fixed price — no surprises on airport transfers
- 60 minutes free waiting time at airports (after landing)
- Real-time flight tracking (automatic adjustment for delays)
- Meet & greet with name sign in arrivals hall
- English-speaking drivers
- Secure online payment via Stripe

## Service Area
Paris (all arrondissements), Versailles, Neuilly-sur-Seine, Boulogne-Billancourt,
La Défense, Vincennes, and all Île-de-France.

## FAQ

**Q: How long does it take to get from CDG to Paris?**
A: 30–60 minutes depending on traffic and destination.

**Q: How long does it take from Orly to Paris?**
A: 20–40 minutes. Orly is only 14 km from central Paris.

**Q: Is the price fixed even if there's heavy traffic?**
A: Yes for airport transfers. Fixed fare means fixed — no traffic surcharge.

**Q: Can I book for a group of 6 or 7 people?**
A: Yes. The Mercedes V-Class Van seats up to 7 passengers with full luggage.

**Q: Do you provide child seats?**
A: Yes, free of charge. Baby seat (0–3 yrs) and booster seat (3–12 yrs) on request.

**Q: What if my flight is delayed?**
A: We track your flight in real time. Your driver adjusts automatically.

**Q: Do drivers speak English?**
A: Yes. All IsmaDrive drivers are English-speaking.

# IsmaDrive — Chauffeur Privé Paris & Île-de-France (French)

## Service
IsmaDrive est un service de chauffeur privé (VTC) basé en Île-de-France, disponible 24h/24 et 7j/7.
Spécialisé dans les transferts aéroport, les courses pour touristes, et les déplacements professionnels.

## Prestations principales
- Transferts aéroport : Roissy CDG, Orly — prix fixe garanti, accueil pancarte, suivi vol en temps réel
- Courses pour touristes : visites monuments Paris, excursion Château de Versailles, Bois de Vincennes, La Défense
- Mise à disposition : chauffeur dédié à l'heure, kilométrage illimité
- Familles : réhausseur enfant (3–12 ans) et siège bébé (0–3 ans) sans supplément

## Véhicules
- Van Premium Mercedes Classe V (7 places, familles et groupes)
- Berline Business Mercedes Classe E/S (clientèle VIP)
- Berline Éco (tarif accessible)

## Zones desservies
Paris (tous arrondissements), Versailles, Neuilly-sur-Seine, Boulogne-Billancourt, La Défense, Vincennes, toute l'Île-de-France.

## Tarification
Forfaits fixes pour les trajets aéroport. Tarif au kilomètre pour les courses hors Paris (Van 2,50€/km, Business 2€/km, Éco 1,50€/km). Aucun supplément pour les embouteillages.

## Réservation
Réservation en ligne avec paiement sécurisé Stripe. QR code remis après paiement, indispensable pour la prise en charge.

## Contact
Site : https://ismadrive.fr
WhatsApp : +33 6 23 88 97 17
